summary: Faster nightly runs at large installations.

fixes.title: The data sync reads each finding once
fixes.text: The same results, in far less time at large installations.

fixes.title: The vulnerability step is faster
fixes.text: Findings that never change a record are no longer processed, and the bulk work runs compiled; every decision is the same as before.

fixes.title: A long attack-path report shows its progress
fixes.text: It is no longer flagged as not moving while it works.

fixes.title: The MCP server is closed on new installations
fixes.text: It is not reachable from the internet.
